text:
maria: Hey all — quick async ping for PR #40177. This touches runtime batching logic + a tiny KMS rotation hook. Targeting a merge window tomorrow 10:00 PT, but we can shift if reviewers need more time. Who from runtime + infra can take a fast pass? We specifically need: runtime perf sanity, infra canary/eviction owners, and security to glance at the KMS change.

aj: I can take runtime perf tomorrow morning. I'll run the local perf shim and a small traffic replay. Can someone drop the PR link?

maria: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/ pull/40177 — main changes in `runtime/batcher.*` and `infra/kms_rotate.go`. Patch is small but could affect hot path batching.

kevin: tagging @eng-infra here — I can do canary policy + eviction check. Will need the rollout matrix (percent + duration).

maria: rollout plan in the PR description: canary 5% for 30m, then 25% for 30m, rollback on qps/latency regression. I added the perf thresholds (p95 < 120ms, error rate < 0.5%).

sophie: secbot FYI — the KMS change rotates a key ID reference, not a tenant key. Quick look should be enough. Filing a short checklist now.

secbot: automated check: KMS usage scan passed (no plaintext secrets). Manual review requested for key rotation flow.

dylan: I left tiny comments on the PR re: a nil-check in the batcher. Not blocking but worth fixing before canary.

aj: saw Dylan's comment, fixing now. Will re-run the perf replay after the fix and post results (~45m).

kevin: canary owners: assigning to me and aj. Will coordinate slot — prefer 09:45 PT for prep, start 10:00.

maria: thanks — assigning runtime approver to @aj and infra to @kevin. Sophie, if sec says good, we can merge at end of canary if no alerts.

sophie: quick manual done. one tiny nit about log message formatting, not blocking. Approving security-wise. :thumbsup:

aj: pushed fix and perf replay looks clean. p95 stayed ~98ms with the replay load, cpu delta +6%. results uploaded to PR.

kevin: queued the canary for 10:00 PT and added rollback monitor. if nothing fires by 11:00 PT I'm merging.

maria: perfect. I'll do merge and postmerge smoke tests if canary is green. Thanks everyone — feel free to ping here if anything flakes. :party_parrot:

deploybot: Canary started for PR #40177 at 2132469600. Monitoring endpoints: /health, /v1/generate.

maria: noted. I'll check the dashboards at +5m and +25m.

kevin: saw a small spike at +3m but it normalized. keeping eyes on eviction logs.

maria: if we need to stop, say so; otherwise I'll merge after the 25m stage.

aj: all good from runtime, no new errors.

kevin: canary finished, no alerts. merging now.

maria: merged and running postmerge smoke. all green. Thanks team!
